name: Kagamiishi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kagamiishi town emblem in green: an outlined cog-like device enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kagamiishi, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 January 1969.

features.role: Kagamiishi town emblem — an outlined cog-like device enclosing a ring
